text: Delightful experience when Took my 9 yr old here, small family run clinic. Dr speaks English. In old town of Chiang Mai. Very Affordable.  Highly recommend !!

Clean clinic. Kind service at the front desk. Dentist and assistants were professional and gentle. The dentist speaks English very well. Had some cavities tended, teeth molded to make a temporary tooth replacement and my whole teeth scaled. No complains, they were careful the whole time. Better make an appointment in advance.

The dentist here is very professional and skilled. I had my wisdom tooth removed, and everything went smoothly.

The procedure was done so gently that I didn’t feel any pain at all. The reception and assistant team were also very friendly and helpful. I’m really happy with their service and highly recommend this clinic. 😊

My wife and I (tourists) visited for a scale and polish. Price was quoted between 700-1000 baht. We were both charged 1000.

I do t have a problem with the price paid as it was significantly cheaper than what it would cost at home.

The service received was of a far lower quality than what I would have received at home however. The entire session lasted 10 minutes. The session included a general scale and then a general polish. Not much time was spent on each individual tooth (no flossing) and the procedure was somewhat painful. Both my wife and my own gums bled quite a bit.

The service overall was ok, my teeth were cleaner when I left than when I went in but I'm afraid that - based on both of our experiences - this is not a place I would recommend.
